hypothesis_results.detail: Dust front-running confirmed mechanically (~50 wei for 50 swaps) but not economically viable. Gas cost >> dust. Informational only.
No unchecked underflow triggered after 10 swaps + withdrawal. consumedLiquidity tracking is consistent.
50 round-trip swaps — reserves consistent. uint256 consumedLiquidity cannot practically overflow.
Hook pricing validated against MIN/MAX bounds. Hook trust model: LP chooses hook, LP bears risk. Self-inflicted config (FP #4).
snapPrice requires liquidity=0 with no initialized ticks between. Cannot exploit when pool has value. Empty pool manipulation = zero economic impact.
Partial withdrawal with addInRange0=true — bounded amounts, no overflow detected. Precision alignment prevents redeposited > value.
Fee asymmetry is intentional (prevents div-by-zero on output path). Not exploitable without admin setting 100% fee.
Off-by-one +1 tolerance caught by AMMModule balance check at line 2208. Cannot compound across transactions.
getPoolState is VIEW call during single external call — no state change between read and use. Reentrancy guard blocks concurrent modifications.
Fallback from swapByInput to swapByOutput: amountIn check at line 49 prevents returning lower amountIn. Fee asymmetry between input/output paths is bounded.
